description: Source code for S3 file loader component, handling loading and processing of documents from S3 buckets, supporting built-in and unstructured processing methods, including handling various file types and metadata.

classes.name: S3_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Class for loading documents from S3, supporting built-in and unstructured processing, handling various file types, and managing metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, deciding between built-in and unstructured processing based on configuration.

methods.name: processWithBuiltInLoaders
methods.description: Processes S3 files using built-in loaders based on content type.

methods.name: processWithUnstructured
methods.description: Processes S3 files using the unstructured API, supporting various options and temporary file handling.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a file buffer based on MIME type, supporting text and binary files.

methods.name: isTextBasedFile
methods.description: Checks if MIME type is a text-based file.

methods.name: isSupportedBinaryFile
methods.description: Checks if MIME type is a supported binary file.

methods.name: processBinaryFile
methods.description: Processes binary files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV) from temporary files.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file from a buffer with appropriate extension.
